title: apis india — Risk & Reputation Research
content:
According to reviews on Indeed, employees of Apis Services Inc. have expressed dissatisfaction, citing toxic management, lack of communication, and constant policy changes. An Instagram post from Apis India highlights a positive review for their Apis Organic Honey, emphasizing customer satisfaction and quality. However, the sources do not provide a definitive answer regarding overall customer complaints and negative reviews for Apis India.
